note: Lions Club-run campground 1.5 miles east of Highway 2A and 13, a few minutes east of Wetaskiwin: playground, two camp kitchens (rentable), horseshoe pits, firewood and a catch-and-release trout pond; a tenting area. --Claude
summary: Read the Lions Club page (Wayback 2026-04-16; live page 403s): 52 sites all 30 A, 27 full / 25 power-water, C$40-45 (monthly C$1,050, yearly C$3,500), showers, laundry, dump, phone 780-352-7258. Wrote fees, hookups (+sewer), sites, facilities (+dump); note rewritten. Stored website domain is dead - replace. Season and booking not stated (left derived). Land ownership unresolved.
flags: WEBSITE (stored https://www.wetaskiwinlions.club/ - DEAD, NXDOMAIN): replace with the club's campground page https://e-clubhouse.org/sites/wetaskiwinab/page-8.php (Google and Travel Alberta both link it; it answers 403 to curl, read via its Wayback capture of 2026-04-16 which answered 200). The page's own 'www.lionscampground.com' is a parked domain (200 but only a '/lander' redirect stub) - do not use.

OWNERSHIP (stored private): the Lions page says 'Wetaskinwin Lions Club operates a 52 site RV Campground 1.5 miles East of Highway 2A and13E' and nothing about the land. Searches of City of Wetaskiwin and County of Wetaskiwin pages found nothing naming the land owner, so the city-vs-club question is UNRESOLVED; left private. A land-title or council-minute check would settle it.

PRICE GATE (stored private): base C$40 (power/water; full service C$45) from the operator page captured 2026-04-16 - under C$69, passes. No unserviced RV rate is posted (tent C$30). Gateway: none within 40 km (Edmonton 63 km).
PHONE: 780-352-7258 (stored) on the page ('For further information phone 1-780-352-7258') and Google - confirmed. GOOGLE: 'Wetaskiwin Lions Campground' 4.5 stars from 136 reviews.

LONG STAY: monthly (C$1,050) and yearly (C$3,500) rates beside a posted nightly rate; nothing marketed as mostly seasonal; ordinary club campground - no concern. Not occupancy-checked (no online engine).

SITE COUNT CONFLICT: the club page says 52 sites (27 full, 25 power/water); Travel Alberta (secondary) says '27 fully serviced sites, 22 power-and-water sites, 25 unserviced sites and dedicated tenting areas' (the old note followed it), and the Explorer RV Club listing says 58. Wrote the operator's 52.

SEASON / BOOKING: the club page states neither a season nor how to reserve; stored derived season 05-01..09-30 ('Approximate') and reservable true left as they are. Travel Alberta: 'Season Availability Spring, Summer, Fall'.

WATERFRONT (stored pond - keep): on Esri imagery (0.62 m/px) the trout pond is about 57 m x 65 m (~0.4 ha, under 1 acre) in the west part of the campground; the loop road and a handful of sites on its east and south-east side sit 10-20 m from the water across open grass, the rest of the 52 sites are 60-180 m away among tree rows. Pond is right for those few sites; per the few-clear-sites rule it may carry a caveat that only the sites along the loop beside the pond face it (site numbers not published).
PIN (52.98766,-113.35200): in the middle of the site loops - no move.
